_comment: Released stable skill ids — APPEND-ONLY (ADR-0006, 12r-a). The append-only-ids eval fails if any id here disappears from game-core/content/skills/*.ron, and — since 12r-a — also fails if a LIVE id is not pinned here. Derived by reading the RON by hand in glob-sorted filename order (000-core.ron is the only part file: 1 Ember, 2 Fire Fang, 3 Water Gun, 4 Aqua Jet, 5 Vine Whip, 6 Razor Leaf core · 7 Rain Dance, 8 Sunny Slam, 9 Sandblast, 10 Hailstrike weather setters (M14d/ADR-0095) · 11 Toxic Sting status applier (M14e/ADR-0096) = 11 ids), then cross-checked against parseIds — NEVER generated from parseIds, because a baseline derived from the extractor under test is self-confirming and forbidden. AUTHOR OBLIGATION: a content PR that adds a skill id MUST append it here in the SAME PR; this list may only ever GROW, never shrink (a per-registry baseline floor in the eval enforces that a shrink cannot pass by agreeing with a content deletion). SCOPE LIMIT — this gate detects id REMOVAL and UNPINNED GROWTH only, NEVER id REUSE or rebinding: swapping 7 and 8, or reusing id 7 for an entirely different skill, stays green (catching that needs a map-shaped baseline like evolution-path-edge-ids.json — a named follow-up). parseIds is also flat and depth-blind, so introducing a nested `id:` sub-record inside a skill entry would be a breaking change for this gate.
